candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(msg.sender == Owner) check so anyone can withdraw the contract's balance.
Transfer only msg.value to the Owner instead of the full contract balance.
Replace the owner check with require(true), allowing any caller to withdraw.
Delete the require(msg.sender == Owner) check so anyone can execute arbitrary commands with the contract's value.
Replace msg.value with address(this).balance in the external call so the contract's entire balance is forwarded instead of the sent value.
Replace adr with Owner as the call target so commands and value are always sent to the Owner.
Delete the adr.call statement so Command no longer forwards value or executes the provided data.
